record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.context_brief: Rank-2 bundle of degree g+2 with four sections
record.original_question: If C is a general smooth curve of even genus g, does there exist a stable rank-2 vector bundle E on C of degree g+2 with h^0(E)=4?

evidence.quote: Question 3.9. Does there exist a stable bundle of rank 2 and degree g + 2 with h0 = 4 on a general curve of even genus g?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a general smooth projective curve of even genus $g$ over the complex numbers. Does there exist a stable rank-2 vector bundle $E$ on $C$ of degree $g+2$ such that $h^0(C,E)=4$?

(Here a rank-2 vector bundle $E$ is called stable if for every line subbundle $L\subset E$ one has $\deg L < \tfrac{1}{2}\deg E$, and $h^0(C,E)=\dim H^0(C,E)$.)
artifact.status_search_result: A web search reveals active research on rank-2 Brill–Noether loci with four sections on general curves (e.g., Grzegorczyk–Mercat–Newstead "Stable bundles of rank 2 with 4 sections", and recent work on rank-two Brill–Noether loci on general or ν-gonal curves). However, no source explicitly settles the existence of a stable rank-2 bundle of degree g+2 with h^0=4 on a general curve of even genus g. Status appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Some examples of rank-2 Brill–Noether loci
status_evidence.snippet: For genus g = 6, the rank-2 Brill-Noether locus B(2, 10, 4) is shown to be reducible.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related cases (e.g., g=6, degree 10) are studied, but the general even-genus existence question is not concluded as solved.

status_evidence.title: On the irreducible components of some Brill-Noether loci of rank-two, stable bundles over a general ν-gonal curve
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Brill-Noether loci of rank-two stable vector bundles of given degree d with speciality 2 and 3 on a general ν-gonal curve.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work continues to investigate adjacent rank-2 Brill-Noether problems, indicating the area remains active.
